description: Income support scheme by the Government of India providing Rs 6,000 per year in three equal four-monthly installments to all landholding farmer families across India directly into their verified bank accounts via Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT).
department: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare
benefits_summary: Direct financial assistance of Rs 6,000 per annum paid in 3 equal installments of Rs 2,000 each via DBT.

criteria.description: Beneficiary must be a small or marginal farmer family holding cultivable agricultural land
criteria.failure_reason: Applicant occupation is not registered as an agricultural farmer or cultivator

criteria.description: Applicant must be an adult aged 18 or above
criteria.failure_reason: Applicant is under the legal adult age of 18

criteria.description: Targeted priority for small and marginal farm holdings under Rs 2,50,000 annual income
criteria.failure_reason: Household income is above the priority smallholder income ceiling

documents.description: Mandatory unique identification for DBT payment authentication
Certified land record evidencing agricultural landholding title

documents.document_name: Bank Passbook with Active NPCI Aadhaar Seeding
documents.description: Bank account statement showing IFSC code and active account status
documents.issuing_authority: Scheduled Commercial Bank / Regional Rural Bank

scheme_name: Ayushman Bharat - Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (PM-JAY)
description: The world's largest health assurance scheme providing a health cover of Rs 5 lakh per family per year for secondary and tertiary care hospitalization to over 12 crore vulnerable and low-income families identified through deprivation criteria.
department: National Health Authority (NHA), Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
benefits_summary: Cashless in-patient health cover up to Rs 5,00,000 per family per year for 1,949 medical and surgical procedures.

criteria.description: Household income must align with low-income socioeconomic classification (below Rs 2,50,000)
criteria.failure_reason: Household income exceeds eligibility criteria for subsidized universal health protection

criteria.description: Priority deprivation criteria including kutcha housing or tenant shelter
criteria.failure_reason: Applicant household owns a permanent pucca structure

documents.description: Eligible ration card or state health card showing family composition
documents.issuing_authority: State Food & Civil Supplies Department / NHA

documents.document_name: Government Photo Identity Proof (Aadhaar / Voter ID)
documents.description: Proof of identity of the undergoing patient

description: Flagship social housing program to provide financial assistance to rural houseless families and those living in kutcha and dilapidated houses for construction of pucca houses with basic amenities like toilet, LPG, electricity, and tap water.
benefits_summary: Financial grant of Rs 1,20,000 in plain areas and Rs 1,30,000 in hilly/difficult areas, plus 90-95 days of unskilled labor wage under MGNREGS.

criteria.description: Applicant must reside in a designated rural panchayat zone
criteria.failure_reason: PMAY-Gramin is strictly restricted to rural panchayat administrative territories

criteria.description: Must currently live in a kutcha house or be houseless with zero pucca dwellings
criteria.failure_reason: Household already owns a permanent pucca house

criteria.description: Annual household income must be within Rs 1,80,000
criteria.failure_reason: Household income exceeds rural housing deprivation ceiling

documents.description: Verification of living in a kutcha house issued by Gram Panchayat

documents.document_name: Aadhaar Card of Head and Family Members
documents.description: Biometric Aadhaar numbers for geo-tagged house tracking

documents.document_name: Bank Passbook Linked to MGNREGA Job Card
documents.description: Account details for phased direct subsidy transfer upon stage verification

description: Government program by Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas to provide deposit-free LPG connections to women from poor and vulnerable households without clean cooking fuels.
department: Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas
source_ref: data.gov.in / Ministry of Petroleum & Natural Gas
benefits_summary: Free LPG gas connection with financial subsidy of Rs 1,600, free first cylinder refill, and free cooking gas stove (hotplate).

criteria.description: Applicant must be an adult female member of the poor household
criteria.failure_reason: PMUY LPG gas connection is issued strictly in the name of an adult female family member

criteria.description: Applicant must have attained 18 years of age
criteria.failure_reason: Applicant is under 18 years of age

criteria.description: Targeted toward BPL and low-income households with annual income under Rs 1,50,000
criteria.failure_reason: Annual household income exceeds the threshold for free LPG welfare connection

documents.description: Proof of household composition issued by State Civil Supplies
Account details for DBT subsidy credits

scheme_name: Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme (IGNOAPS)
description: Non-contributory monthly pension scheme under the National Social Assistance Programme (NSAP) providing social security and economic dignity to elderly citizens living below the poverty line.
department: Ministry of Rural Development (National Social Assistance Programme)
benefits_summary: Monthly pension of Rs 200/month (ages 60-79) and Rs 500/month (ages 80+), supplemented by state government contributions.

criteria.description: Applicant must have completed at least 60 years of age
criteria.failure_reason: Applicant is below the statutory retirement age of 60 years

criteria.description: Must belong to a household living below the recognized poverty line (BPL)
criteria.failure_reason: Annual household income exceeds the BPL social security pension limit of Rs 1,20,000

documents.document_name: Age Proof Certificate (Voter ID / Birth Certificate / School Marksheet)
documents.description: Government document showing birth date or age 60+
documents.issuing_authority: Election Commission / Health Dept / Municipal Authority

documents.description: Proof of living below the poverty line
Designated savings account for monthly pension deposit
